```{r}
## normalized to row sum() in excel to get `cccounts-pct.tsv` percentages of cell cycle phase, header needs to be 1 item shorter for row.names to be detected
## hierarchical clustering based on cell cycle
cccounts.pct <- read.table("cccounts-pct.tsv", header = TRUE)
dtest <- dist(t(cccounts.pct), method = "euclidean")
fit <- hclust(dtest, method="ward")
plot(fit)

```

```{r}
## Cell cycle scoring based on cluster and sample

ccCountHash <- table(dc$Phase, dc$seurat_clusters, dc$HTO_maxID)
library(gridExtra)
plots <- list() 
for (i in seq(4)) {
  plots[[i]] <- ggheatmap(as.data.frame.matrix(round(prop.table(ccCountHash[,,i], 2)*100, 1)), orderCol = F, colorPalette = "PuRd")
}
do.call(grid.arrange, c(plots, ncol = 2))

write.csv(ccCountHash,"analysis/ccCountHash.csv" , row.names=FALSE)
saveRDS(ccCountHash, "analysis/ccCountHash.rds")

## stupid way
ccCountHash2 <- table(dc$Phase, dc$seurat_clusters, dc$HTO_maxID)
ccCountHash2[,,1] <- round(prop.table(ccCountHash[,,1], 2)*100, 1)
ccCountHash2[,,2] <- round(prop.table(ccCountHash[,,2], 2)*100, 1)
ccCountHash2[,,3] <- round(prop.table(ccCountHash[,,3], 2)*100, 1)
ccCountHash2[,,4] <- round(prop.table(ccCountHash[,,4], 2)*100, 1)
## or
for (i in seq(4)) {ccCountHash2[,,i] <- round(prop.table(ccCountHash[,,i], 2)*100, 1)}

## better way using prop.table() function
ccCountHashPct <- round(prop.table(ccCountHash, c(3,2))*100, digits =1)
saveRDS(ccCountHashPct, "ccCountHashPct.rds")
##view table
# ftable(ccCountHash, row.vars = 2)

```

```{r}
## Calculate DC differentiation score
dc.genes <- list(c('Ager', 'Azi2', 'Batf', 'Batf2', 'Batf3', 'Camk4', 'Ccl19', 'Ccr7', 'Cd40lg', 'Cebpb', 'Csf2', 'Dcstamp', 'F2rl1', 'Flt3', 'Gata1', 'H2-M3', 'Il4', 'Irf4', 'Ltbr', 'Lyn', 'Notch2', 'Pirb', 'Prtn3', 'Psen1', 'Rbpj', 'Relb', 'Spi1', 'Tgfb1', 'Tgfbr2', 'Tmem176a', 'Tmem176b', 'Tnfsf9', 'Traf6', 'Trem2', 'Trpm2', 'Ubd', 'Zbtb46'))
dc <- AddModuleScore(dc, dc.genes, name = "dcDifScore") 
FeaturePlot(dc, features = "dcDifScore1", split.by = "HTO_maxID", ncol = 2) 

```

```{r}
## Calculate survival score http://www.informatics.jax.org/go/term/GO:0043066
## 927 genes
survGenes <- scan("analysis/survivalGenes.txt", what="", sep=",")
dc <- AddModuleScore(dc, list(survGenes), name = "survSco")
FeaturePlot(dc, features = "survSco1", split.by = "HTO_maxID", ncol = 2) 
```

```{r}
## Calculate death score http://www.informatics.jax.org/go/term/GO:0043065
## 642 genes
deathGenes <- scan("deathGenes.txt", what="", sep=",")
dc <- AddModuleScore(dc, list(deathGenes), name = "deathSco")
FeaturePlot(dc, features = "deathSco1", split.by = "HTO_maxID", ncol = 2) 
```

```{r}
# library(future)

Idents(dc) <- "seurat_clusters"
clusMarkers <- FindAllMarkers(dc, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
```

```{r}
#Save clusMarkers into csv file
write.csv(clusMarkers, "Markers_all_16_clusters.csv")
ttable <- clusMarkers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_logFC)
write.csv(ttable, "Top10_markers_all_16_clusters.csv")
ttable <- clusMarkers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 4, wt = avg_logFC)
write.csv(ttable, "Top4_markers_all_16_clusters.csv")
```
